question: Who among the following personalities won the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2021 for their contribution to the 'Chhau' dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhuvan Kumar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhuvan Kumar won the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2021 for his contribution to the 'Chhau' dance.**
 
• Chhau is a traditional dance form originating from eastern India.
 
• It is particularly from the states of **Jharkhand, Odisha, and West Bengal.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bijay Kumar Jena is a renowned Odissi dancer and choreographer.**

 
 
• He has been awarded the Padma Shri and Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for his contribution to the field of dance.
 
 
 
• **Rabindra Atibudhi is a renowned folk music singer from Odisha.**
 
 
• He has been awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for his contribution to the field of music.
 
 
 
• **Trilochan Mohanta is a renowned sculptor and artist from Odisha.**
 
 
• He has been awarded the Padma Shri and National Award for his contribution to the field of art.
